terra.problem: “Holy” and “pure heart” may be hard for a 10-year-old to understand. Use simpler words for being devoted to God and wanting to do what is right.
“God’s grace” and “rests on Christ’s perfect obedience” may be hard for a 10-year-old. Explain grace as God’s undeserved kindness and say more plainly that Jesus always obeyed God.
